name: aurora-background
title: Aurora Background
description: A full-bleed animated backdrop of out-of-focus white and blue streaks over a near-black field. It drifts slowly and continuously, wrapping whatever children you place on it.
use: A hero or landing section needs an ambient backdrop that moves slowly without stealing attention.
avoid: The blur and drifting motion cost paint on low-end phones, and there is no reduced-motion stop.
a11y: No reduced-motion check, so the drifting gradient keeps moving for users who ask motion to stop. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A near-black stage filled by a soft, out-of-focus vertical gradient: broad white and pale blue streaks blurring into indigo, with a faint warm brown edge. A small white caption sits in the middle.
behaves: The blurred bands drift slowly sideways and shift in brightness, never settling, so the backdrop keeps moving behind its content. Nothing reacts to the pointer.
customise: Wrap your content as children and turn the corner fade off with showRadialGradient; the band colours live in inline CSS variables you edit by hand.
weight: light: One blurred gradient layer animated in CSS; no canvas or script.
demo: The words 'Aurora Background' in white at the centre of the stage.
issues: Heavy blur turns the repeating streaks into a flat smear, with little colour visible.
polishWhy: Soft believable drift, but blur flattens the bands and the white caption fades on bright areas.
